name: Local Text Embedding (Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B)
purpose: Embed text (single or batch) into L2-normalized dense vectors that serve as SEMANTIC ADDRESSES for the Collective Agent memory substrate (governing sec 6.3). Serves the pre-provisioned Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (arch Qwen3Model, hidden_size 1024, max_position_embeddings 32768) through a TRANSIENT Python worker (embed_worker.py) under the CUDA speech venv (transformers + torch; last-token pooling + optional L2 normalize). Returns vectors in EXACT INPUT ORDER with full model/version/sha256/engine provenance and a per-input status; empty and oversize inputs are flagged and skipped (null vector) -- never a crash, never a silent truncated/garbage vector. GPU work runs under the res.lease `gpu` mutex (one heavyweight resident) which this skill self-manages. Defines the embedding-provider interface that artifact.search (Module 36) consumes (D-0077 shared contract). NOT a vector store / ingestion / retrieval / router -- just the adapter.

invocation.args_spec: Named params: -Text <string> | -Texts <string[]> (batch); -Normalize <bool=true>; -Instruction <string> (optional Qwen3-Embedding query-instruct prefix; default none = document/raw); -MaxTokens <int=32768> (oversize threshold); -Dtype <fp32|fp16|bf16=fp32>; -Device <cuda|cpu=cuda>; -Mock (deterministic numpy stub, no model/torch/GPU/lease); -ModelId <id=embedding.qwen3-0p6b>; -ModelPath/-ModelSha256/-Registry overrides; -PythonExe/-WorkerPath overrides; -GpuLease <auto|off|require=auto>; -GpuLeaseHolder/-GpuTtlSeconds/-GpuWaitSeconds; -ResLeasePath/-PwshPath; -ArtifactRoot/-InvocationId; -MockDim/-MockSeed. OR -InputsJson '<json {text|texts, normalize, instruction, max_tokens, dtype, device, mock, model_id, model_path, model_sha256, python_exe, mock_dim, mock_seed}>'.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: A single text to embed. Provide this OR texts.

inputs.name: texts
inputs.description: A batch of texts to embed; vectors are returned in EXACT input order (result[i] <-> input[i]).

inputs.name: normalize
inputs.description: L2-normalize each vector (unit length -> cosine == dot). false returns raw pooled vectors.

inputs.name: instruction
inputs.description: Optional Qwen3-Embedding query-instruct prefix ('Instruct: {instruction}\nQuery: {text}'). Default none = document/raw embedding. QUERY-side callers should set the same instruction the corpus was NOT embedded with (asymmetric); documents stay raw.

inputs.name: max_tokens
inputs.description: Oversize threshold. An input whose real token count exceeds this is flagged status=oversize and skipped (vector null) -- never truncated silently. Default = the model's max_position_embeddings.

inputs.name: dtype
inputs.description: Compute dtype: fp32 (default, most deterministic) | fp16 | bf16 (model native).

inputs.name: device
inputs.description: cuda (default; runs under the gpu lease) or cpu (the CPU-fallback path; no lease).

inputs.name: mock
inputs.description: Deterministic seeded-numpy stub with NO torch/model/GPU/lease -- exercises the schema/shape/normalization/input-order/empty-oversize seams off-machine.

outputs.description: { op:'embed', model_id, model_version, model_sha256, engine_build, pooling, dim:int, normalized:bool, count:int, vectors:[[float]|null] (EXACT input order; null for skipped), per_input:[{index,status:'ok'|'empty'|'oversize',n_tokens}], instruction, max_tokens, device, dtype, timings{load_ms,embed_ms}, peak_vram_bytes, peak_ram_bytes, lease{...} }. Full provenance in model_provenance[]. Deterministic within a documented tolerance (see SCHEMA_NOTES.md).

executables: python>=3.10 (CUDA speech venv, with transformers>=4.57 + torch + safetensors + numpy)
models: embedding.qwen3-0p6b (Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, safetensors dir; type=embedding; wired for this module)
requirements.gpu: cuda (11GB sufficient; ~2.5GB fp32 peak; cpu fallback available)
